lines.text: [excited] Imagine being the weakest hunter on Earth... and selling the one thing that can turn anyone into a monster slayer. For ten rupees a glass.
[warm] Hello friends, I'm Manoj, and this one's our very own webtoon, The F-Rank Tea Seller. Episode one. Grab your tea, because tea is kind of the whole point.
[mysterious] So it's twenty thirty-one, and there are monster Gates in every city on Earth. Hunters walk in, fight whatever's inside, and walk out rich. Well... the ones who walk out.
Right next to the biggest Gate in Mumbai, there's a tiny tea stall.
[funny] That's Arjun. Eighteen, rank F, which is the lowest rank they've got, so instead of fighting monsters, he sells tea to the people who do. Business? Not great.
Then the real hunters show up. Viktor Hale, B-Rank, two million followers... and honestly, zero manners.
[funny] Viktor spots Arjun and decides the whole street needs to know he's an F-Rank tea boy.
Arjun just smiles and offers him a glass, good for the nerves before a dungeon, he says.
[funny] Viktor, being Viktor, goes: tea from an F-Rank? Is it poisoned with weakness?
[warm] Luckily Meera, the healer, is the only nice one on the team, and she pays for three teas.
Viktor drinks his in one gulp, says it's nothing special, and walks off.
[mysterious] But watch Arjun's face here. That little smile. Because in his head, he's counting: one hour. That's all you get.
[serious] Inside the dungeon, things go wrong fast. Ogres and monster wolves come out of the dark.
Their tank gets thrown across the cave, shield and all.
Viktor takes a nasty cut to the arm, and these monsters are way too strong for level nine.
Meera's already shouting at everyone to get out.
[shocked] Then, out of nowhere, Viktor's hands start to glow. Golden light, all over his body, and he has no idea where it's coming from.
[excited] One swing... and the giant ogre is just gone.
[funny] His team can't believe it. Did he just one-shot that thing?
Viktor, of course, decides he's finally awakened. Bold.
For the next fifty-eight minutes, he's unstoppable. He goes through that dungeon like the monsters are made of paper.
[serious] Then they reach the boss. A giant minotaur, black armor, and an axe the size of a car.
Viktor jumps in for the final hit... and the clock reaches sixty minutes.
[funny] The golden light just fizzles out. Viktor's face says it all. Oh no.
So they do the smartest thing any hunter can do. They run.
They crawl out of the Gate, barely alive.
[shocked] Viktor marches straight back to the tea stall, grabs Arjun, and yells: what did you put in that tea?
[funny] Arjun, totally calm, just says... cardamom.
[funny] Meera just holds up her coins and asks if she can get one to go. Honestly? Smartest person in the story.
[mysterious] That night, when the street's empty, we finally see Arjun's secret.
It's a hidden skill called Hunter's Chai. Rank unknown. Anyone who drinks it borrows huge power, for exactly one hour.
[funny] Arjun's only thought? Ten rupees for an hour of power... he's undercharging.
[mysterious] Here's the thing, though. Deep inside that Gate, a giant red eye just opened, and it's looking right at the tea stall.
Ten rupees a glass. One hour of borrowed power. And something in the dark that just noticed.

[warm] You can read episode one free on WEBTOON, just search The F-Rank Tea Seller, and episode two is on the way. So tell me: what do you think is inside that Gate? I've got a theory... but I'm not telling yet.
